verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success, professional skill, or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

repayment-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference the successful repayment of previous loans are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

female-family-future-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their family fund faster.
female-family-future-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly mention securing the future of their family are associated with increased funding speed.

operational-specificity-faster-general.title: Providing specific operational or inventory details predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
operational-specificity-faster-general.body: Pitches that include precise details about inventory items or operational data, rather than general categories, fund faster for both men and women.

female-children-details-faster.title: Female borrowers who provide specific details about their children fund faster.
female-children-details-faster.body: Pitches from women that specify the number, age, or schooling status of their children are associated with increased funding speed.

male-education-faster-puzzle.body: Male borrowers who mention education or learning conditions for themselves or their children may fund faster.

female-survival-needs-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention using the loan for basic survival needs, such as food, may fund more slowly.

female-financial-educational-goals-faste.body: Female borrowers who mention concrete financial or educational goals may fund faster.

male-asset-goals-faster.body: Male borrowers who mention long-term goals of asset acquisition, such as land, may fund faster.

female-income-specificity-slower.body: Providing specific monthly income amounts may predict slower funding for female borrowers.

female-business-longevity-faster-puzzle.body: Female borrowers who mention being in business for multiple years may fund faster.

female-husband-occupation-faster.body: Female borrowers who specify the occupation of their husband may fund faster.

female-marital-status-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention their marital status may fund more slowly.

female-age-faster.body: Female borrowers who include their age in the pitch may fund faster.

female-nwtf-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention previous loans from NWTF may fund more slowly.

female-verbosity-faster-puzzle.title: For female borrowers, increased pitch length may correlate with faster funding, contradicting the general trend.
female-verbosity-faster-puzzle.retrospective: FIFO - dropped oldest to maintain cap.

male-repayment-promises-slower.title: Male borrowers who make explicit promises of timely repayment may fund more slowly.
male-repayment-promises-slower.retrospective: FIFO - dropped oldest to maintain cap.

female-children-count-slower.title: Mentioning the specific number of children may predict slower funding for female borrowers.
female-children-count-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence that specifying number of daughters and sons accelerates funding for women.

female-education-volunteering-slower-puz.title: Female borrowers who provide specific details about education or social volunteering may fund more slowly.
female-education-volunteering-slower-puz.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap for new observation regarding institution mentions.

female-inventory-specificity-slower.title: While operational specificity generally accelerates funding, female borrowers who provide detailed lists of supplies or product types fund more slowly.
female-inventory-specificity-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific inventory items accelerate funding for women.

female-gratitude-slower-puzzle.title: Female borrowers who use explicit gratitude markers in their pitches may fund more slowly.
female-gratitude-slower-puzzle.retrospective: Dropped to make room for new observation regarding husband's occupation.

female-children-education-slower-puzzle.title: Female borrowers who mention the educational needs of their children may fund more slowly.
female-children-education-slower-puzzle.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence that specifying schooling status of children accelerates funding for women.

female-institutional-details-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention specific loan amounts or the lending organization may fund more slowly.
female-institutional-details-slower.retrospective: Dropped oldest puzzle to maintain puzzle cap for new observation on direct address.

female-direct-address-faster.title: Female borrowers who address lenders directly in their pitch may fund faster.
female-direct-address-faster.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap for new observations.

female-location-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention specific towns or regions in their pitch may fund faster.
female-location-specificity-faster.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap for new observations.
